assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
the precertification requirement (CO-197) is being challenged as medically unnecessary

the claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied based on Reason Code CO-197 indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
